description: One node for YouTube: search videos, get a channel's stats and latest videos, a video's full transcript, or its comments. Each action has its own price. Use it when: A task needs YouTube: finding videos, sizing up a channel, summarising or quoting what a video says, or reading how viewers reacted. Not for: Downloading video files, private or members-only videos. Returns: Depends on the action; see the actions table. Typical time: about 30 s. Actions: search (find videos on a topic; needs query); transcript (get the full transcript of a video; needs url); comments (read the comments on a video; needs url); channel (a channel's stats and its latest 10 videos; needs handle). Price: from $0.005 per call, charged only on success. Price depends on action: transcript $0.005, channel $0.015, search $0.042, comments $0.042 (default search). One call = one YouTube action (search, channel, transcript or comments).

action.description: What to do; sets the price. search (needs query), transcript (needs url), comments (needs url), channel (needs handle). Default search

handle.description: The channel handle without @, e.g. NatGeo (for: channel)

language.description: Caption language code, e.g. en, de, es; default en (for: transcript)

query.description: What to search for, e.g. home espresso machine review (for: search)

url.description: The video URL, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aircAruvnKk (for: transcript, comments)

name: youtube
title: YouTube data: search, channels, transcripts
